questions.question: What is the primary value of an AI champion?
options: Turning scattered experiments into reusable assets, shared standards, and better team habits
Approving every AI use case alone
questions.explanation: Champions scale learning and reuse without becoming the only decision point.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Recurring questions indicate a need for champion enablement or reusable assets.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked champion backlog with priority, controls, and rationale

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: Office hours are one practical champion enablement control.

questions.question: When should champion work escalate rather than stay as informal support?
options: When impact, uncertainty, or risk signals are high
Only when no one asks for help
Only when the prompt is short
Never; champions should solve every issue alone
questions.explanation: Champions should escalate high-risk or unclear issues to the right owners.

questions.question: Why does the course use a champion backlog?
options: To focus enablement on repeated team needs and reusable assets
To hide requests from the community
questions.explanation: The backlog keeps champion work focused and reusable.
